beats: Turning a spare TV stick into a kitchen display used to mean buying a paid licence.
Without it, the screen just reverts back to the normal Android home screen.
Or it drains the battery with an idle animation nobody asked for.
So now a tiny app registers itself as the stick's actual home screen.
It boots straight into a clock showing glucose, time, and the weather.
No licence, no fallback screen - the cost comes down to zero.
